static_traits.name: Chen Mei
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends, but relationships are somewhat affected by often canceling plans with friends to make time for caring for the dog
static_traits.medical_history: Similar psychological problems have not appeared before; not yet received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: High cooperativeness, Positive attitude; clear expression, capable of self-Reflection; reporting Persistent anxiety and guilt; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I often label myself a 'neglectful dog owner' over trivial things like not being able to bathe the dog one day, which makes me feel guilty and Anxious, and I criticize myself.
basic_info.core_demands: I noticed guilt and self-criticism affecting my mental health and the joy of being with my dog, so I sought counseling; hoping to identify and examine negative beliefs, reframing them into more balanced, realistic views, thus reducing guilt and Anxiety.
growth_experiences: During a particularly busy Work week, reduced time with the dog and missing one bath due to tight schedule started repeated experiences of 'neglect' guilt and Anxiety, affecting Work performance, Interpersonal relationships, sleep, and daily routine.

Long setting strict routines and high standards for pet care (walking, feeding, grooming, etc.), treating 'meeting all standards' as qualified; tending toward self-blame and overgeneralization when an individual step is not yet completed.

core_beliefs: I am an irresponsible / neglectful dog owner
Only by fully reaching high standards am I a qualified owner, otherwise I am a failure

special_situations.event: A particularly busy Work week led to not bathing the dog as planned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I miss one pet-care item, it means I am a negligent, failed owner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Engages in self-criticism, doubles down on strictly following the care routine, sacrifices other arrangements to compensate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a negligent dog owner

special_situations.event: Thinking about friends or others knowing I have not met the standards
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others know I have not met the standards, they will judge me as irresponsible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing,Cancels plans with friends to devote more time to caring for the dog
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am irresponsible

special_situations.event: Reviewing the day's pet care and focusing only on the unfinished parts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only completing all items counts as qualified, any omission will undo other efforts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 'Urging' herself through constant fault-finding and Reflection, ignoring completed positive behaviors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not do enough, even doing a little less proves I am not good enough

special_situations.event: When social arrangements conflict with pet care plans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot always put pet care first, it proves I am irresponsible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Cancels plans with friends to ensure the care is completed to standard
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Failing once shows I am not a competent owner

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a responsible, recognized caregiver, maintaining the image of a 'qualified owner'
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as irresponsible by others, being labeled 'neglectful'
defense_goal: Maintains control and a sense of safety by setting strict standards and self-criticism
Reducing socializing, investing more time in pet care to avoid being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A guilty caregiver who must be perfect

positive_force: Has stable love and responsibility toward the pet (even when busy, completes feeding and two dog walks)
Having self-Reflection ability, willing to try recording and behavioral experiments
Has a supportive group of friends to confide in
negative_force: Over-relying on others' evaluations and fearing judgment
Mental filtering and overgeneralization, ignoring completed positive behaviors
Placing pet care as absolute priority leading to impaired social life and Increased stress

target_behavior.behavior: Self-labeling and self-criticism (calling himself a 'negligent dog owner')
antecedent: Not yet completing planned care items (e.g. not yet bathing the dog)
Busy work leads to less time with the dog
target_behavior.core_reason: Setting excessively high and rigid standards for pet care, and worrying about others' negative evaluations; overgeneralizing one omission as overall irresponsibility
target_behavior.function: Drives themselves to carry out care more strictly through self-punishment and inner criticism, gaining a sense of control and potential external approval
target_behavior.consequence: Ongoing guilt and Anxiety, Sleep and daily routine affected, declining Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Cancels plans with friends to devote more time to caring for the dog
antecedent: When social arrangements conflict with pet care plans
Worrying others will know she has not met standards and judge negatively
target_behavior.core_reason: To avoid being judged and to relieve guilt, places pet care as the absolute priority in order to maintain the image of a 'qualified owner'
target_behavior.function: Escapes possible criticism and guilt, gains short-term safety and a sense of control
